measuredSpectrum.source: UVES Paranal Observatory Project (Bagnulo et al., ESO), merged spectrum of HD 29712 (R Doradus)

gaps.reason: UVES chip gap: the merged spectrum stores zero flux from about 576 to 585 nm

measuredSpectrum.note: VLT/UVES echelle spectrum taken 2002-12-27, with a relative calibration from the pipeline response curve. The atmospheric dispersion corrector was off and the slit was 0.5 arcseconds wide, so light was lost unevenly with wavelength: the overall colour is uncertain. Zero-flux samples are the chip gaps and are left out; the 576-585 nm gap is bridged by a straight line.
